/value/0/description.value: A withered twig that was used as a hairstick, with new flower buds sprouting on the end. Now, the past is long gone, and the stick inlaid with parcel-gilt flower buds commemorates the beginning of a new life.

/value/1/description.value: Bracers made from flowing coral gold and the leather of unknown beasts. Only master artisans from the Vidyadhara dragon race can create this kind of superior armor.

/value/10/description.value: A heavy breastplate decorated with the distinctive symbols of the Church of Purity Palace. Even the joints are airtight.

/value/100/description.value: A wide-brimmed sun hat with a pearlescent sheen. Sailors racing across the seas use it to shield themselves from Aquila's scorching sun.

/value/101/description.value: A nautical compass that captures the guidance of starlight. Even when adrift in the boundless darkness of the sea, the stars will always point the way forward.

/value/102/description.value: The sailing cloak billowed like a great sail. If the strong winds will not aid me, then I shall become the wind itself.

/value/103/description.value: Shattered waves bloomed beneath the captain's boots. Even if he never returned, the tides would carry back his blessing.

/value/104/description.value: The hood that the legendary Deliverer wore to shield {F#herself}{M#himself} from storms. In actuality, it is probably nothing like what the bards describe.

/value/105/description.value: The gauntlets worn by the legendary Deliverer as {F#she}{M#he} blazed through adversities. In actuality, it is probably nothing like what the bards describe.

/value/106/description.value: The battle robe worn by the legendary Deliverer when {F#she}{M#he} engaged in combat. In actuality, it is probably nothing like what the bards describe.

/value/107/description.value: The boots worn by the legendary Deliverer as {F#she}{M#he} trampled over mountains and braved through tides. In actuality, it is probably nothing like what the bards describe.

/value/108/description.value: A classic, wide-brimmed fedora with a rollable brim. Very popular among intellectuals, artists, and professionals.

/value/109/description.value: A beautiful metal mesh band, paired with a minimalist round dial. Cool, precise, and industrial. Also understated, practical, and unpretentious.

/value/11/description.value: Standard boots distributed to the Knights of the Church of Purity Palace, with a simple word carved on their heels: Order.

/value/110/description.value: A brown corduroy jacket. He often wears it unbuttoned to break away from the frame of meticulousness.

/value/111/description.value: A more sturdy and durable high-top lace-up leather shoe suitable for less formal occasions. Still maintains an elegant touch.

/value/112/description.value: The magical girl's candy-colored bow hairpin, shining like a glittering medal.

/value/113/description.value: Multi-functional magical girl gloves, combining entertainment and combat capabilities. Pure white hands, protecting everyone's wishes.

/value/114/description.value: A customized multipurpose combat suit that doubles as an idol's performance miniskirt. Comfortable, lightweight, and stain-resistant.

/value/115/description.value: First-class wear-resistant boots. True promises are built not on words, but on the steps you take to fulfill them.

/value/116/description.value: The external jade abacus worn by Jingtian. Knowing well that human strength could never fathom fate, he used it to ceaselessly divine the future.

/value/117/description.value: After losing an arm on the battlefield of Thalassa, Jingtian crafted himself a prosthetic arm, which was as cold and precise as his divinations.

/value/118/description.value: The standard-issue ritual robe of the Yuque Divination Commission is typically reserved for formal occasions. Due to its rare use, it still looks as good as new.

/value/119/description.value: Cloud boots crafted by Jingtian allowed him to fly onto battlefields and gather information. They are now displayed in the Yuque's Divination Commission, serving as a testament to future generations.

/value/12/description.value: A hood made from the head of a huge Snow Plains bear. The fur seems to be possessed by some ghost or deity, making it invulnerable to physical attacks.

/value/120/description.value: A telescope meticulously crafted by the Navigator. He witnessed life being born from barren stardust, and also saw destruction rise from the beyond.

/value/121/description.value: The Navigator's die ring: every spin poses a curious riddle. He seems to have played the game with many. Some walked away winners, others vanished without a trace.

/value/122/description.value: Woven into the unassuming patterns on the Navigator's uniform are intricate astral charts mapping every journey the Astral Express has ever taken. Each golden thread traces a voyage across the stars.

/value/123/description.value: The Navigator's tailor-made leather boots, rumored to possess a special magical power that guides their wearer to every place where they're decidedly not welcome.

/value/124/description.value: A forging mask used by Zhuming craftsmen in the image of a Fire Beast. A fire crystal is embedded in the forehead to protect the craftsmen from both searing vapors and invasive hallucinations.

/value/125/description.value: A multifunctional gauntlet worn by Zhuming craftsmen to assist with exerting force during the forging process. The fusion of cold iron and flame patterns not only provides indestructible durability, but also embodies the will to tame fire into a sharpened edge.

/value/126/description.value: A craftsman's shirt woven from fire-washed brocade. Even when standing beside a roaring furnace, it maintains a lingering inch of coolness around the wearer.

/value/127/description.value: To counteract the crushing gravity field at the Zhuming's core, the craftsmen created heavy boots equipped with recoil suspension devices, allowing them to move about freely.

/value/128/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the Herta Space Station. Parked above The Blue, it slowly drifts along its predetermined orbit, with the silent cosmos looking like a book waiting to be read.

/value/129/description.value: Madam Herta lost all interest in the space station the moment it was complete. The station maintains a steady orbital velocity as it circles The Blue, leaving a track of its circular motion on the planet below.

/value/13/description.value: A pair of tactical gloves, on which scaly claws of snowrock lizards are tightly sewn. It can be used to safely climb up and hang on to any wall.

/value/130/description.value: The Xianzhou Luofu floating above the seas of stars was enclosed within the sphere. Skiffs went to and fro through the Jade Gate just like the celestial movements of stars and moons. Countless people had come here to seek the secrets of immortality, only to return in disappointment.

/value/131/description.value: Once, the Luofu reigned supreme over other ships in the Xianzhou fleet due to the grace of the Ambrosial Arbor. Later, when people consumed the cursed fruit of immortality, calamity was brought upon the Luofu by the Ambrosial Arbor, whose vines had already entrapped the Luofu in its firm and inseparable grip.

/value/131/name.value: The Xianzhou Luofu's Ambrosial Arbor Vines

/value/132/description.value: The IPC's headquarters at Pier Point is sealed within a Planar Sphere. No planet can hide from the grand business plan of the Interastral Peace Corporation. They ventured into deep space to harvest the power of the entire universe.

/value/133/description.value: With the convenient help of the credit system, interstellar commerce was established. The Interastral Peace Corporation connected the stars with economic activity and expanded the borders of trade.

/value/134/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Everwinter Monument, the most iconic landmark in Belobog's Administrative District. Those passing by this monument can all feel a distant and warm gaze protecting them.

/value/135/description.value: The Silvermane Guards of Belobog stood firmly in the icy winter storm, forming a line as they wait for the incoming assault from invaders beyond the sky. The will of the Silvermane Guards was indestructible, and their line of defense would never falter.

/value/136/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the core of Planet Screwllum, imprisoned in a cage composed of countless levers, pistons, and gears. The inhabitants of Planet Screwllum euphemistically refer to it as the "Steel Sun."

/value/137/description.value: The planetary ring supports all of Planet Screwllum. Just how many are aware that the dense porous rectangular array reflects the truth about the planetary system?

/value/138/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is one of Salsotto's last remaining moving cities — Tumbleweed. This city never stopped and barely escaped from a fate of being swallowed up either by the dark night or the midnight sun.

/value/139/description.value: Planet Salsotto's own rotation stopped, and thus each cycle of its day and night seemed to last forever. People can only gain the bare minimum space for survival when they ceaselessly migrated and closely chased the ever-moving terminator line.

/value/14/description.value: A cloak made from the fine scales of the Ice Dragon, nearly invisible under the brilliant refraction of light.

/value/140/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Talia's miserable desolate small town called Nailscrap. For a short-lived peace, bandits chose this place for its water supplies and built this small town out of rags, rebars, and planks.

/value/141/description.value: This is a stretch of wire scavenged from the junkyard. Despite bits of its insulation falling off, there is still some use left in it. No such thing as useless trash exists in Talia's small bandit towns.

/value/142/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Wacq Island, the most well-known island on Planet Vonwacq. Teeming with plant life, the island houses a gigantic tree called Thestang, bearing fruits that would give birth to the various kinds of the island's wildlife.

/value/143/description.value: On the coastline of Wacq Island, tidal waves rose and fell... This landscape remained the same for millennia and witnessed the rise and fall of civilizations just like those changing tides.

/value/144/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the most advanced arena on Planet Taikiyan — the Taikiyan Stadium. The atmosphere is lively both inside and outside the dome as flags wave in the air. With all eyes on the arena, an exciting game of Roboball is about to kick off.

/value/145/description.value: The Taikiyan Stadium's standard race track is usually made with a metal structure covered with smooth concrete and natural wooden floors. A large amount of transparent polycarbonate material was used in the construction of the stadium to give the audience an unobstructed view of the games.

/value/146/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the Insumousu Autonomous Region of Thalassa. The Xianzhou Daiyu had crashed here, inspiring the civilization of Insumousu.

/value/147/description.value: The fallen Xianzhou Daiyu is forever anchored in a foreign land. Perhaps it is time to untie its mooring ropes and let it return home.

/value/148/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is the renowned shapeshifting oothecae of the Glamoth Empire's Iron Cavalry. Countless silver mechas were loaded into warships and sailed to the outer edges of the galaxy to fend off the vicious Swarm from deep space.

/value/149/description.value: The flourishing Empire of Glamoth turned into dust. There was no evidence of its former glory. Only the debris of stardust, mechas, warships, and the corpses of the Swarm were left drifting in the vacuum to form a river of residua — preserving the original battle scene of the bloody warfronts and serving as a monument to its downfall.

/value/15/description.value: A pair of enhanced power boots wrapped in soft elk fur. With these, the hunter will only leave shallow footprints behind in the Snow Plains.

/value/150/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Penacony's main structure — the Reverie hotel. Guests staying here will travel to a world of sweet dreams and enjoy a feast of luxury and extravagance in a seemingly omnipotent metropolis.

/value/151/description.value: In Penacony's dreamscape city, intricate tracks meander between buildings, supporting the Spheroids that visitors ride in, and connecting rich and diverse dreams together.

/value/152/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the most habitable zone in Sigonia-IV — the desolate barren desert known as the Gaiathra Berth. The silent and unassuming Gaiathra Triclops, with her immense and weighty torso, quietly encompasses all the living and deceased in Sigonia.

/value/153/description.value: Turquoise meteorites are meticulously polished and shaped, then strung together with gold threads and viridescent silk by the Avgins. They believe that these protective knots must not be buried in the sand, but radiate like the Mother Goddess' divine body reborn from death on the night of Kakava.

/value/154/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Izumo, with its past and future severed with a slash. Izumo was once covered in indescribable wars of survival, as well as once being blessed with glorious days of bountiful luxury... Now, the barren land is nowhere to be found, leaving behind only a graveyard of swords where the past lies buried.

/value/155/description.value: The people of Izumo use tassels to bind the sharp blades to their belts. They walk the world to hunt down Kami with their blades, then used the divine carcasses to forge new blades... In this never-ending cycle, Izumo marches toward prosperity, towards disillusion, and towards the void.

/value/155/name.value: Izumo's Blades of Origin and End

/value/156/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the Golden Sky Tent belonging to the borisins of Verdantia. Different to the savage name that borisin left in the cosmos, the borisins of Verdantia possess outstanding biotechnology. The children of the wolves gather next to the great Brood Lord Duran, and regard the celestial objects in the sky as their herd as they gallop between the stars.

/value/157/description.value: These were the reins, shackles, and whips. The first thing taught to borisin youths who had grown taller than war beasts' legs was to always grasp the reins tight in their hands, or else the youths themselves would become enslaved livestock — or worse, become feed.

/value/158/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the Flamewheel Forge, the location of the Xianzhou Zhuming's Artisanship Commission. A sphere the size of a celestial body, constructed around the progenitor of all heliobi, the Flint Emperor. Ingenious artisans draw energy from it and mold wondrous thoughts and inspirations into form.

/value/159/description.value: The heliobus progenitor, as grand in scope and size as a star, drowns in an endless dream. As it slumbers, the atoms and molecules around its body clash and spark, endlessly permeating outward from the external shell crafted from the Flamewheel, ultimately appearing as iridescent light bands resembling strands of celestial silk.

/value/16/description.value: Boxing headgear that provides excellent protection. It perfectly fits the shape of the owner's face.

/value/160/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is a submerged city in the marine world Lushaka. The sea level rose to the point where even the city was drowned. Only gigantic "stateships" carrying their sailors chug along across the sea, in search of the direction for their next distant voyage.

/value/161/description.value: On the boundless horizon, even the faintest mark can shatter this silence. The navigational lanes bear the history of the crew while the aqua sprites pursue hope along the water currents.

/value/162/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is a scientific organization's laboratory. Due to memetic corruption, true and false information has been completely mixed together, becoming impossible to separate. As such, this place has been cognitively reshaped into "BananAmusement Park."

/value/163/description.value: Optical cables that can be seen everywhere within the lab. They are used to collect experimental information to reach secretive goals that must not see the light of day. For the "Bananas," the way to perceive the world lurks within.

/value/164/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is Aidonia of Amphoreus. Believers of {RUBY_B#Death Titan}Thanatos{RUBY_E#} have raised colossal monuments on the snow plains, offering tribute to the Holy Maiden who brings them the blessing of death.

/value/165/description.value: Animal bones, arrowheads, and caltrops bind the world of the Aidonians with that of the dead. The ascetics of the wastelands only hoped that their souls, unyielding, could pass through the frozen depths, and would not become lost from poverty or weakness on the way to seeing their god.

/value/166/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is Amphoreus' Grove of Epiphany, where the divine corpus of the Bough of Rift, {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}, ponders. "The First Scholar" led others to establish gardens and courtyards within the woods and shared knowledge, and the Grove was born.

/value/167/description.value: The golden threads and vines weave a network in the Grove, becoming a lifeline through which schools share their findings. Information enters from the roots, unraveled and deconstructed through the leaves' veins, until it becomes a drop of dew merging into the Library of Philia's pool.

/value/168/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is the Membrance Maze of Aedes Elysiae. Brush aside the golden wheat, and down, down, down you tumble into a deep tree hollow. Huh? There are so many little fairies! "One two three four five six seven?" Wrong! It's "Do re mi fa sol la si!"

/value/169/description.value: A flute whistle, shaped from clay. It symbolizes the promise between the little fairies and the two children. Whenever the boy and girl blew into it — "Mem?" — the tree hole leading to the maze would open, and the fairies would welcome them back with joy.

/value/17/description.value: A pair of boxing gloves kept in excellent condition. Some slight wear doesn't hinder their effectiveness.

/value/170/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is Styxia, the city drowned in eternal revelry. A lighthouse remains endlessly lit upon the shore, playing ceaseless melodies. Ships, lured by merry tunes, sail through the mists only to run aground and sink, their shattered wreckage devoured by the tide.

/value/171/description.value: The people of Styxia firmly believe that the sea sirens, just as the legends say, guard their paradise with flesh and blood. And that one day, drawn by the lighthouse's endless cantillation, they will arrive at last, rewarded with an eternal feast.

/value/172/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is a chapter named An Eternal Page from As I've Written. It has been imbued with the fragrance of flowers, the warmth of the west wind... and an open ending.

/value/173/description.value: At the story's end, the data of thirty million cycles transforms into a complete poem, and the years written by the Recorder will remain in the cosmic memory, never fading away.

/value/174/description.value: The Planar Sphere encapsulates countless streaming windows in its digital space. It's a virtual society deeply interwoven with reality, a fantastical yet detached imaginary metropolis, an alternate life that anyone can peek into and participate within.

/value/175/description.value: The Tengoku@Livestream might not be heaven. The countless messages flooding the chat windows can build glory or bring destruction, as it was never an isolation from reality, but rather an extension of it.

/value/176/description.value: Encapsulated within the Planar Sphere is Punklorde's Rainbow City. Day and night blur into one, the virtual and real have no boundaries, and life exists as fleeting bytes of data.

/value/177/description.value: In the flowing currents of the network, hackers' cartridges connect with one another. What surges through isn't just data. It's the very lives of the hackers themselves.

/value/178/description.value: Encased within the Planar Sphere lies Astropolis: the lofty headquarters of the Interastral Peace Entertainment. This media capital has churned out countless superstars, broadcasting entertainment products across the cosmos with industrial-grade precision.

/value/179/description.value: Employee credentials from Astropolis, marked with rank and personnel information. Perhaps of everything above and beneath the sky, one of the very few things they share.

/value/18/description.value: A boxer's professional-level chest guard. The outer and inner padding is designed to provide protection while not hindering movement.

/value/180/description.value: A withered twig that was used as a hairstick, with new flower buds sprouting on the end. Now, the past is long gone, and the stick inlaid with parcel-gilt flower buds commemorates the beginning of a new life.

/value/181/description.value: Bracers made from flowing coral gold and the leather of unknown beasts. Only master artisans from the Vidyadhara dragon race can create this kind of superior armor.

/value/182/description.value: An old coat with a ragged hemline. The embroidery has been ruined by blade marks. Flesh heals quickly, but a coat does not, nor does a person's pain.

/value/183/description.value: A durable pair of boots that have left shoe-prints on many worlds and have witnessed many lethal situations.

/value/184/description.value: A cowboy hat decorated with wild wheat — a mark of the legendary Musketeer Oakley.

/value/185/description.value: A pair of leather gloves with partially cracked surfaces. The part where one holds a gun is particularly worn out.

/value/186/description.value: A knitted cape in an ethnic style, lined with bulletproof fibers.

/value/187/description.value: These riding boots have a V-shaped cutout. Appearing casual and loose, they are also very comfortable to wear.

/value/188/description.value: A casque that resembles the religious stone statues of the Goddess of Forgiveness. It was used to hide the wearer's appearance.

/value/189/description.value: A silver ring decorated with an ecclesiastical pattern, embedded with a rather cloudy gemstone.

/value/19/description.value: Intricately crafted from leather and mesh, the combination of a thick insole and thin outsole ensures the wearer can be agile on their feet.

/value/2/description.value: An old coat with a ragged hemline. The embroidery has been ruined by blade marks. Flesh heals quickly, but a coat does not, nor does a person's pain.

/value/20/description.value: A standard-issue helmet that covers the head and face. It has lining inside to help keep its wearer warm.

/value/200/description.value: A standard-issue helmet that covers the head and face. It has lining inside to help keep its wearer warm.

/value/201/description.value: Metal gauntlets that give off a silvery sparkle. A complex mechanical structure is hidden within its design.

/value/202/description.value: A neatly-ironed uniform of the Silvermane Guards from long ago. The sturdy buttons press creases in the fabric.

/value/203/description.value: A pair of hard, silver-white metal greaves. They provide protection while also being lightweight and warm.

/value/204/description.value: Protective goggles crafted from dark-black fire crystals. Through these lenses, even the flurry of intense sparks becomes a mosaic of dull shadows.

/value/205/description.value: A ring with a symbol of flames. It is the highest symbol of honor among the Firesmith clan.

/value/206/description.value: A blacksmith's apron without any superfluous adornment. The texture of the leather and the family emblem are clearly visible.

/value/207/description.value: A prosthetic produced from metallic alloy. Its surface is entwined with vivid fiery carvings.

/value/208/description.value: A pair of communication goggles embedded with ultraremote sensing technology that breaks through the shackles of limited transmission and remote distances.

/value/209/description.value: A pair of gloves equipped with a precision frequency-capture device, which enables direct manipulation of otherwise-intangible sound and light vibrations.

/value/21/description.value: Metal gauntlets that give off a silvery sparkle. A complex mechanical structure is hidden within its design.

/value/210/description.value: Diving-suit-like attire that envelops the body when activated, sending neural signals from your whole body to the metafield in real time.

/value/211/description.value: A wearable gravity-capture device. It is shaped like a pair of ice skates that reflects the stars' twinkling lights during quick gliding.

/value/212/description.value: A pair of classic sunglasses worn by one of the lead singers, Janis, whose chrome lenses reflect a blue hue.

/value/213/description.value: Bassist Sid's bracelet, woven from silk wristbands from tours. Several lines of lyrics are written on it.

/value/214/description.value: David, one of the band's lead singers, drew a white star on the back of this leather jacket and made it the cover of the band's final album.

/value/215/description.value: Drummer Bonham's ankle boots, the dark leather surface glued with rivets reflecting the stage lights.

/value/216/description.value: An aerodynamic helmet used in high-speed flights. It is shaped like the beak of a skyfish eagle.

/value/217/description.value: A ring worn by an outstanding skyfisher master, with a pair of skyfish eagle's wings holding tight the wearer's finger.

/value/218/description.value: A belt harness that connects the winged suit with metal supports embedded in thick linen. Soft and tight-fitting.

/value/219/description.value: Puttees to keep the legs warm during flights, decorated with a skyfish eagle's bristle feathers.

/value/22/description.value: A neatly-ironed uniform of the Silvermane Guards from long ago. The sturdy buttons press creases in the fabric.

/value/220/description.value: A mask used to change one's facial appearance. Coupled with evocative acting skills, it can help you deceive anyone.

/value/221/description.value: A pair of special gloves interlaced with nanomaterials. The prints on its surface can change in real time.

/value/222/description.value: A steel cable disguised as a woven belt, with hooks and pulleys hidden in its buckle.

/value/223/description.value: A pair of boots that enhances any human's physical prowess. It helps the Meteor Thief stride between buildings.

/value/224/description.value: A breathing mask able to filter sand and radiation out from the air. It seems like it was made from a discarded respirator.

/value/225/description.value: Multi-functional trash that can detect ionizing radiation in the air. It can also trash-talk.

/value/226/description.value: A baggy robe adapted from a missionary's attire.

/value/227/description.value: The leg part of powered armor, an exoskeleton made from scrap metals and old wires.

/value/228/description.value: An ingenium eye that once belonged to someone. After being expelled from its owner's body, it is now completely useless.

/value/229/description.value: An ingenium prosthetic limb made specifically for long-life species. Requires no invasive procedure to use.

/value/23/description.value: A pair of hard, silver-white metal greaves. They provide protection while also being lightweight and warm.

/value/230/description.value: A feather garb made according to old scrolls. Its owner was either a demon reviled in the pages of history or a savior of humanity.

/value/231/description.value: A pair of silk boots with soles as thin as cicada's wings. Its owner must not have walked on their feet for a long time.

/value/232/description.value: The shape is exactly like a ski goggle. Not only does it have anti-glare properties, it can also be used to watch virtual live streams.

/value/233/description.value: A cybernetic prosthetic arm that can be disassembled at will. Capable of firing knuckles like bullets.

/value/234/description.value: A trendy courier satchel. It's adorned with many cute accessories.

/value/235/description.value: A pair of sneakers that support parkour activities. It is comfortable, and that is all it needs.

/value/236/description.value: A crown of unceasing flame, with its burning ambition serving as its inexhaustible fuel.

/value/237/description.value: Pure white gloves with flames as its fur, hiding its brutality under smooth silk.

/value/238/description.value: A gorgeous robe that emphasizes the dignity and elegance of its owner.

/value/239/description.value: A pair of classic and comfortable boots in pristine condition, with a sleek design and flattering style.

/value/24/description.value: Protective goggles crafted from dark-black fire crystals. Through these lenses, even the flurry of intense sparks becomes a mosaic of dull shadows.

/value/240/description.value: A muzzle designed to tightly encage the captive's beastly visage, guarding against the feral fangs that yearn to inflict harm.

/value/241/description.value: Heavy shackles that tightly bind the evildoer's hands with steel needles pinning into the wrists, preventing the vicious claws from doing harm again.

/value/242/description.value: A prisoner's garment that restrains dangerous criminals. Its reversed-joint design confines the prisoner's body.

/value/243/description.value: Metal shackles that bind the feet of the beasts, imprisoning evils and preventing them from escaping and wrecking havoc.

/value/244/description.value: A heavy diving helmet in a style common in Orkron. Through the small porthole, one can only see the unbearable and endless expanse of darkness.

/value/245/description.value: A compass in the form of a wristwatch. The magnetic needle has been removed and can no longer point in any direction.

/value/246/description.value: A heavy diving suit crafted from scrap iron, airtight and impenetrable. Even its wearer often jests that it resembles more of a deep-sea coffin.

/value/247/description.value: The heavy boots are formed like the anchor of a ship. Its owner is prepared to never return to the surface.

/value/248/description.value: An eyepiece with gold carvings. The lens reflects the wonders from far away to help its owner peer through the illusory dreams.

/value/249/description.value: A wristwatch of fine craftsmanship. It contains a unique watch face and clock hands. It is said to be the symbol of good luck in the Dreamscape.

/value/25/description.value: A ring with a symbol of flames. It is the highest symbol of honor among the Firesmith clan.

/value/250/description.value: A splendid and luxurious formal suit with leather collars. It is magnificent and elegant, usually reserved for formal occasions such as feasts.

/value/251/description.value: A pair of elegant leather shoes. The wearer had once stealthily walked upon dreams in an enigmatic form.

/value/252/description.value: An iron helm that significantly enhances sensory signals, fusing the consciousness of the Glamoth Iron Cavalry together with their armor.

/value/253/description.value: A powerful iron wristguard that can crush insectoids. It is sharp and light while being hard and sturdy.

/value/254/description.value: The fiery propulsion armor gives Glamoth's Iron Cavalry a flame hot enough to ignite the battlefield.

/value/255/description.value: Mechanical greaves that combine destructive capacities with speed. They allow Glamoth's Iron Cavalry to leap high and concentrate their strength into a kick directed at a single point on the enemy.

/value/256/description.value: A face mask modeled after the ferocious bird "Dafeng." With its two pairs of auxiliary eyes, it has witnessed divine miracles.

/value/257/description.value: A bionic gauntlet integrated with the body. To hunt fearsome beasts, one must possess claws sharper than those of the beasts themselves.

/value/258/description.value: Like the cold wind, soaring above a pack of wolves with their heads held high. The hunter and the hunted will eventually switch places.

/value/259/description.value: Combat boots fashioned after talons. They allow the wearer to swiftly dash onto the battlefield like the wind, effortlessly traversing through thorns and rugged terrain.

/value/26/description.value: A blacksmith's apron without any superfluous adornment. The texture of the leather and the family emblem are clearly visible.

/value/260/description.value: He often sits in the confessional booth listening to the stories. The earrings serve as a constant reminder that even the faintest whispers have their weight.

/value/261/description.value: He often stands in the mansion to greet visitors, countless times making the gesture of invitation. The pristine gloves remind him of observances of humility and courtesy.

/value/262/description.value: He often stands before the dressing mirror, ensuring his attire is impeccable and his features perfect. Before he leaves the house, he will ensure that everything is meticulously arranged, and no deviations will occur.

/value/263/description.value: He often chose boots that snugly embrace his feet before embarking on his journeys. Despite numerous falls, he rose each time.

/value/264/description.value: A crystal monocle reflecting a grand building, demonstrating its owner's sophistication and erudition along with the cane, bracelet, and brooch.

/value/265/description.value: An exoskeleton crafted from an alloy that aids finger movements, tailored to the user's hand and of significant value.

/value/266/description.value: Tweed jackets paired with knitwear are a commonplace attire at the academy. For visiting scholars, its durable fabric is an ideal choice.

/value/267/description.value: These cozy and stylish women's boots have accompanied their owner on polar expeditions for years, being perfectly in-fashion when paired with calf-length pants.

/value/268/description.value: Wreath awarded to the coliseum champion. Every gold leaf shimmers with courage and glory.

/value/269/description.value: A pair of elite bracers for the barrier troops commander. They tightly wrap around the warrior's wrists, steadfastly supporting the trumpet of victory.

/value/27/description.value: A prosthetic produced from metallic alloy. Its surface is entwined with vivid fiery carvings.

/value/270/description.value: Armor akin to a god's, perfectly fitting the bodily contours of a powerful physique.

/value/271/description.value: Tight-fitting shinguards around a warrior's legs, its contours elegant and durable, imbued with the spirit to never retreat.

/value/272/description.value: Before the Temple of Dusk in spring, the most outstanding of bards will receive a dill wreath bequeathed by Mnestia.

/value/273/description.value: A bracelet crafted from favored metal. The evil dragon in the story was once fettered in shackles made from this metal.

/value/274/description.value: Dawn is the gentlest time of the day, her skirt is coincidentally also the colors of the last string of stars before dawn.

/value/275/description.value: Woven shoes inlaid with silver studs, pressing worded patterns across the sand she treads. On her mission to gather all the poems of the past, she has never once ceased her footsteps.

/value/276/description.value: This winged helm once bore witness to the Daythunder Knight toppling the sky god, and it also witnessed the sky closing its eyes.

/value/277/description.value: These gauntlets have accompanied the knight to victory in every battle. They grant the strength to grip the deadliest weapons, and endure the most agonizing betrayals.

/value/278/description.value: This cloak shielded the Daythunder Knight from rain and dust, accompanying her through every adventure, leaving behind the most striking silhouette in the sky.

/value/279/description.value: These spurs were a gift from the Daythunder Knight's two winged beast companions. This was the necessary pain to walk a path in pursuit of truth.

/value/28/description.value: A pair of communication goggles embedded with ultraremote sensing technology that breaks through the shackles of limited transmission and remote distances.

/value/280/description.value: A wide-brimmed sun hat with a pearlescent sheen. Sailors racing across the seas use it to shield themselves from Aquila's scorching sun.

/value/281/description.value: A nautical compass that captures the guidance of starlight. Even when adrift in the boundless darkness of the sea, the stars will always point the way forward.

/value/282/description.value: The sailing cloak billowed like a great sail. If the strong winds will not aid me, then I shall become the wind itself.

/value/283/description.value: Shattered waves bloomed beneath the captain's boots. Even if he never returned, the tides would carry back his blessing.

/value/284/description.value: The hood that the legendary Deliverer wore to shield {F#herself}{M#himself} from storms. In actuality, it is probably nothing like what the bards describe.

/value/285/description.value: The gauntlets worn by the legendary Deliverer as {F#she}{M#he} blazed through adversities. In actuality, it is probably nothing like what the bards describe.

/value/286/description.value: The battle robe worn by the legendary Deliverer when {F#she}{M#he} engaged in combat. In actuality, it is probably nothing like what the bards describe.

/value/287/description.value: The boots worn by the legendary Deliverer as {F#she}{M#he} trampled over mountains and braved through tides. In actuality, it is probably nothing like what the bards describe.

/value/288/description.value: A classic, wide-brimmed fedora with a rollable brim. Very popular among intellectuals, artists, and professionals.

/value/289/description.value: A beautiful metal mesh band, paired with a minimalist round dial. Cool, precise, and industrial. Also understated, practical, and unpretentious.

/value/29/description.value: A pair of gloves equipped with a precision frequency-capture device, which enables direct manipulation of otherwise-intangible sound and light vibrations.

/value/290/description.value: A brown corduroy jacket. He often wears it unbuttoned to break away from the frame of meticulousness.

/value/291/description.value: A more sturdy and durable high-top lace-up leather shoe suitable for less formal occasions. Still maintains an elegant touch.

/value/292/description.value: The magical girl's candy-colored bow hairpin, shining like a glittering medal.

/value/293/description.value: Multi-functional magical girl gloves, combining entertainment and combat capabilities. Pure white hands, protecting everyone's wishes.

/value/294/description.value: A customized multipurpose combat suit that doubles as an idol's performance miniskirt. Comfortable, lightweight, and stain-resistant.

/value/295/description.value: First-class wear-resistant boots. True promises are built not on words, but on the steps you take to fulfill them.

/value/296/description.value: The external jade abacus worn by Jingtian. Knowing well that human strength could never fathom fate, he used it to ceaselessly divine the future.

/value/297/description.value: After losing an arm on the battlefield of Thalassa, Jingtian crafted himself a prosthetic arm, which was as cold and precise as his divinations.

/value/298/description.value: The standard-issue ritual robe of the Yuque Divination Commission is typically reserved for formal occasions. Due to its rare use, it still looks as good as new.

/value/299/description.value: Cloud boots crafted by Jingtian allowed him to fly onto battlefields and gather information. They are now displayed in the Yuque's Divination Commission, serving as a testament to future generations.

/value/3/description.value: A durable pair of boots that have left shoe-prints on many worlds and have witnessed many lethal situations.

/value/30/description.value: Diving-suit-like attire that envelops the body when activated, sending neural signals from your whole body to the metafield in real time.

/value/300/description.value: A telescope meticulously crafted by the Navigator. He witnessed life being born from barren stardust, and also saw destruction rise from the beyond.

/value/301/description.value: The Navigator's die ring: every spin poses a curious riddle. He seems to have played the game with many. Some walked away winners, others vanished without a trace.

/value/302/description.value: Woven into the unassuming patterns on the Navigator's uniform are intricate astral charts mapping every journey the Astral Express has ever taken. Each golden thread traces a voyage across the stars.

/value/303/description.value: The Navigator's tailor-made leather boots, rumored to possess a special magical power that guides their wearer to every place where they're decidedly not welcome.

/value/304/description.value: A forging mask used by Zhuming craftsmen in the image of a Fire Beast. A fire crystal is embedded in the forehead to protect the craftsmen from both searing vapors and invasive hallucinations.

/value/305/description.value: A multifunctional gauntlet worn by Zhuming craftsmen to assist with exerting force during the forging process. The fusion of cold iron and flame patterns not only provides indestructible durability, but also embodies the will to tame fire into a sharpened edge.

/value/306/description.value: A craftsman's shirt woven from fire-washed brocade. Even when standing beside a roaring furnace, it maintains a lingering inch of coolness around the wearer.

/value/307/description.value: To counteract the crushing gravity field at the Zhuming's core, the craftsmen created heavy boots equipped with recoil suspension devices, allowing them to move about freely.

/value/308/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the Herta Space Station. Parked above The Blue, it slowly drifts along its predetermined orbit, with the silent cosmos looking like a book waiting to be read.

/value/309/description.value: Madam Herta lost all interest in the space station the moment it was complete. The station maintains a steady orbital velocity as it circles The Blue, leaving a track of its circular motion on the planet below.

/value/31/description.value: A wearable gravity-capture device. It is shaped like a pair of ice skates that reflects the stars' twinkling lights during quick gliding.

/value/310/description.value: The Xianzhou Luofu floating above the seas of stars was enclosed within the sphere. Skiffs went to and fro through the Jade Gate just like the celestial movements of stars and moons. Countless people had come here to seek the secrets of immortality, only to return in disappointment.

/value/311/description.value: Once, the Luofu reigned supreme over other ships in the Xianzhou fleet due to the grace of the Ambrosial Arbor. Later, when people consumed the cursed fruit of immortality, calamity was brought upon the Luofu by the Ambrosial Arbor, whose vines had already entrapped the Luofu in its firm and inseparable grip.

/value/311/name.value: The Xianzhou Luofu's Ambrosial Arbor Vines

/value/312/description.value: The IPC's headquarters at Pier Point is sealed within a Planar Sphere. No planet can hide from the grand business plan of the Interastral Peace Corporation. They ventured into deep space to harvest the power of the entire universe.

/value/313/description.value: With the convenient help of the credit system, interstellar commerce was established. The Interastral Peace Corporation connected the stars with economic activity and expanded the borders of trade.

/value/314/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Everwinter Monument, the most iconic landmark in Belobog's Administrative District. Those passing by this monument can all feel a distant and warm gaze protecting them.

/value/315/description.value: The Silvermane Guards of Belobog stood firmly in the icy winter storm, forming a line as they wait for the incoming assault from invaders beyond the sky. The will of the Silvermane Guards was indestructible, and their line of defense would never falter.

/value/316/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the core of Planet Screwllum, imprisoned in a cage composed of countless levers, pistons, and gears. The inhabitants of Planet Screwllum euphemistically refer to it as the "Steel Sun."

/value/317/description.value: The planetary ring supports all of Planet Screwllum. Just how many are aware that the dense porous rectangular array reflects the truth about the planetary system?

/value/318/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is one of Salsotto's last remaining moving cities — Tumbleweed. This city never stopped and barely escaped from a fate of being swallowed up either by the dark night or the midnight sun.

/value/319/description.value: Planet Salsotto's own rotation stopped, and thus each cycle of its day and night seemed to last forever. People can only gain the bare minimum space for survival when they ceaselessly migrated and closely chased the ever-moving terminator line.

/value/32/description.value: A pair of classic sunglasses worn by one of the lead singers, Janis, whose chrome lenses reflect a blue hue.

/value/320/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Talia's miserable desolate small town called Nailscrap. For a short-lived peace, bandits chose this place for its water supplies and built this small town out of rags, rebars, and planks.

/value/321/description.value: This is a stretch of wire scavenged from the junkyard. Despite bits of its insulation falling off, there is still some use left in it. No such thing as useless trash exists in Talia's small bandit towns.

/value/322/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Wacq Island, the most well-known island on Planet Vonwacq. Teeming with plant life, the island houses a gigantic tree called Thestang, bearing fruits that would give birth to the various kinds of the island's wildlife.

/value/323/description.value: On the coastline of Wacq Island, tidal waves rose and fell... This landscape remained the same for millennia and witnessed the rise and fall of civilizations just like those changing tides.

/value/324/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the most advanced arena on Planet Taikiyan — the Taikiyan Stadium. The atmosphere is lively both inside and outside the dome as flags wave in the air. With all eyes on the arena, an exciting game of Roboball is about to kick off.

/value/325/description.value: The Taikiyan Stadium's standard race track is usually made with a metal structure covered with smooth concrete and natural wooden floors. A large amount of transparent polycarbonate material was used in the construction of the stadium to give the audience an unobstructed view of the games.

/value/326/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the Insumousu Autonomous Region of Thalassa. The Xianzhou Daiyu had crashed here, inspiring the civilization of Insumousu.

/value/327/description.value: The fallen Xianzhou Daiyu is forever anchored in a foreign land. Perhaps it is time to untie its mooring ropes and let it return home.

/value/328/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is the renowned shapeshifting oothecae of the Glamoth Empire's Iron Cavalry. Countless silver mechas were loaded into warships and sailed to the outer edges of the galaxy to fend off the vicious Swarm from deep space.

/value/329/description.value: The flourishing Empire of Glamoth turned into dust. There was no evidence of its former glory. Only the debris of stardust, mechas, warships, and the corpses of the Swarm were left drifting in the vacuum to form a river of residua — preserving the original battle scene of the bloody warfronts and serving as a monument to its downfall.

/value/33/description.value: Bassist Sid's bracelet, woven from silk wristbands from tours. Several lines of lyrics are written on it.

/value/330/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Penacony's main structure — the Reverie hotel. Guests staying here will travel to a world of sweet dreams and enjoy a feast of luxury and extravagance in a seemingly omnipotent metropolis.

/value/331/description.value: In Penacony's dreamscape city, intricate tracks meander between buildings, supporting the Spheroids that visitors ride in, and connecting rich and diverse dreams together.

/value/332/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the most habitable zone in Sigonia-IV — the desolate barren desert known as the Gaiathra Berth. The silent and unassuming Gaiathra Triclops, with her immense and weighty torso, quietly encompasses all the living and deceased in Sigonia.

/value/333/description.value: Turquoise meteorites are meticulously polished and shaped, then strung together with gold threads and viridescent silk by the Avgins. They believe that these protective knots must not be buried in the sand, but radiate like the Mother Goddess' divine body reborn from death on the night of Kakava.

/value/334/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is Izumo, with its past and future severed with a slash. Izumo was once covered in indescribable wars of survival, as well as once being blessed with glorious days of bountiful luxury... Now, the barren land is nowhere to be found, leaving behind only a graveyard of swords where the past lies buried.

/value/335/description.value: The people of Izumo use tassels to bind the sharp blades to their belts. They walk the world to hunt down Kami with their blades, then used the divine carcasses to forge new blades... In this never-ending cycle, Izumo marches toward prosperity, towards disillusion, and towards the void.

/value/335/name.value: Izumo's Blades of Origin and End

/value/336/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the Golden Sky Tent belonging to the borisins of Verdantia. Different to the savage name that borisin left in the cosmos, the borisins of Verdantia possess outstanding biotechnology. The children of the wolves gather next to the great Brood Lord Duran, and regard the celestial objects in the sky as their herd as they gallop between the stars.

/value/337/description.value: These were the reins, shackles, and whips. The first thing taught to borisin youths who had grown taller than war beasts' legs was to always grasp the reins tight in their hands, or else the youths themselves would become enslaved livestock — or worse, become feed.

/value/338/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is the Flamewheel Forge, the location of the Xianzhou Zhuming's Artisanship Commission. A sphere the size of a celestial body, constructed around the progenitor of all heliobi, the Flint Emperor. Ingenious artisans draw energy from it and mold wondrous thoughts and inspirations into form.

/value/339/description.value: The heliobus progenitor, as grand in scope and size as a star, drowns in an endless dream. As it slumbers, the atoms and molecules around its body clash and spark, endlessly permeating outward from the external shell crafted from the Flamewheel, ultimately appearing as iridescent light bands resembling strands of celestial silk.

/value/34/description.value: David, one of the band's lead singers, drew a white star on the back of this leather jacket and made it the cover of the band's final album.

/value/340/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is a submerged city in the marine world Lushaka. The sea level rose to the point where even the city was drowned. Only gigantic "stateships" carrying their sailors chug along across the sea, in search of the direction for their next distant voyage.

/value/341/description.value: On the boundless horizon, even the faintest mark can shatter this silence. The navigational lanes bear the history of the crew while the aqua sprites pursue hope along the water currents.

/value/342/description.value: Encapsulated in the plane is a scientific organization's laboratory. Due to memetic corruption, true and false information has been completely mixed together, becoming impossible to separate. As such, this place has been cognitively reshaped into "BananAmusement Park."

/value/343/description.value: Optical cables that can be seen everywhere within the lab. They are used to collect experimental information to reach secretive goals that must not see the light of day. For the "Bananas," the way to perceive the world lurks within.

/value/344/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is Aidonia of Amphoreus. Believers of {RUBY_B#Death Titan}Thanatos{RUBY_E#} have raised colossal monuments on the snow plains, offering tribute to the Holy Maiden who brings them the blessing of death.

/value/345/description.value: Animal bones, arrowheads, and caltrops bind the world of the Aidonians with that of the dead. The ascetics of the wastelands only hoped that their souls, unyielding, could pass through the frozen depths, and would not become lost from poverty or weakness on the way to seeing their god.

/value/346/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is Amphoreus' Grove of Epiphany, where the divine corpus of the Bough of Rift, {RUBY_B#Reason Titan}Cerces{RUBY_E#}, ponders. "The First Scholar" led others to establish gardens and courtyards within the woods and shared knowledge, and the Grove was born.

/value/347/description.value: The golden threads and vines weave a network in the Grove, becoming a lifeline through which schools share their findings. Information enters from the roots, unraveled and deconstructed through the leaves' veins, until it becomes a drop of dew merging into the Library of Philia's pool.

/value/348/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is the Membrance Maze of Aedes Elysiae. Brush aside the golden wheat, and down, down, down you tumble into a deep tree hollow. Huh? There are so many little fairies! "One two three four five six seven?" Wrong! It's "Do re mi fa sol la si!"

/value/349/description.value: A flute whistle, shaped from clay. It symbolizes the promise between the little fairies and the two children. Whenever the boy and girl blew into it — "Mem?" — the tree hole leading to the maze would open, and the fairies would welcome them back with joy.

/value/35/description.value: Drummer Bonham's ankle boots, the dark leather surface glued with rivets reflecting the stage lights.

/value/350/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is Styxia, the city drowned in eternal revelry. A lighthouse remains endlessly lit upon the shore, playing ceaseless melodies. Ships, lured by merry tunes, sail through the mists only to run aground and sink, their shattered wreckage devoured by the tide.

/value/351/description.value: The people of Styxia firmly believe that the sea sirens, just as the legends say, guard their paradise with flesh and blood. And that one day, drawn by the lighthouse's endless cantillation, they will arrive at last, rewarded with an eternal feast.

/value/352/description.value: Encapsulated in the Planar Sphere is a chapter named An Eternal Page from As I've Written. It has been imbued with the fragrance of flowers, the warmth of the west wind... and an open ending.

/value/353/description.value: At the story's end, the data of thirty million cycles transforms into a complete poem, and the years written by the Recorder will remain in the cosmic memory, never fading away.

/value/354/description.value: The Planar Sphere encapsulates countless streaming windows in its digital space. It's a virtual society deeply interwoven with reality, a fantastical yet detached imaginary metropolis, an alternate life that anyone can peek into and participate within.

/value/355/description.value: The Tengoku@Livestream might not be heaven. The countless messages flooding the chat windows can build glory or bring destruction, as it was never an isolation from reality, but rather an extension of it.

/value/356/description.value: Encapsulated within the Planar Sphere is Punklorde's Rainbow City. Day and night blur into one, the virtual and real have no boundaries, and life exists as fleeting bytes of data.

/value/357/description.value: In the flowing currents of the network, hackers' cartridges connect with one another. What surges through isn't just data. It's the very lives of the hackers themselves.

/value/358/description.value: Encased within the Planar Sphere lies Astropolis: the lofty headquarters of the Interastral Peace Entertainment. This media capital has churned out countless superstars, broadcasting entertainment products across the cosmos with industrial-grade precision.

/value/359/description.value: Employee credentials from Astropolis, marked with rank and personnel information. Perhaps of everything above and beneath the sky, one of the very few things they share.

/value/36/description.value: An aerodynamic helmet used in high-speed flights. It is shaped like the beak of a skyfish eagle.

/value/360/description.value: A withered twig that was used as a hairstick, with new flower buds sprouting on the end. Now, the past is long gone, and the stick inlaid with parcel-gilt flower buds commemorates the beginning of a new life.

/value/361/description.value: Bracers made from flowing coral gold and the leather of unknown beasts. Only master artisans from the Vidyadhara dragon race can create this kind of superior armor.

/value/362/description.value: An old coat with a ragged hemline. The embroidery has been ruined by blade marks. Flesh heals quickly, but a coat does not, nor does a person's pain.

/value/363/description.value: A durable pair of boots that have left shoe-prints on many worlds and have witnessed many lethal situations.

/value/364/description.value: A cowboy hat decorated with wild wheat — a mark of the legendary Musketeer Oakley.

/value/365/description.value: A pair of leather gloves with partially cracked surfaces. The part where one holds a gun is particularly worn out.

/value/366/description.value: A knitted cape in an ethnic style, lined with bulletproof fibers.

/value/367/description.value: These riding boots have a V-shaped cutout. Appearing casual and loose, they are also very comfortable to wear.

/value/368/description.value: A casque that resembles the religious stone statues of the Goddess of Forgiveness. It was used to hide the wearer's appearance.

/value/369/description.value: A silver ring decorated with an ecclesiastical pattern, embedded with a rather cloudy gemstone.

/value/37/description.value: A ring worn by an outstanding skyfisher master, with a pair of skyfish eagle's wings holding tight the wearer's finger.

/value/370/description.value: A heavy breastplate decorated with the distinctive symbols of the Church of Purity Palace. Even the joints are airtight.

/value/371/description.value: Standard boots distributed to the Knights of the Church of Purity Palace, with a simple word carved on their heels: Order.

/value/372/description.value: A hood made from the head of a huge Snow Plains bear. The fur seems to be possessed by some ghost or deity, making it invulnerable to physical attacks.

/value/373/description.value: A pair of tactical gloves, on which scaly claws of snowrock lizards are tightly sewn. It can be used to safely climb up and hang on to any wall.

/value/374/description.value: A cloak made from the fine scales of the Ice Dragon, nearly invisible under the brilliant refraction of light.

/value/375/description.value: A pair of enhanced power boots wrapped in soft elk fur. With these, the hunter will only leave shallow footprints behind in the Snow Plains.

/value/376/description.value: Boxing headgear that provides excellent protection. It perfectly fits the shape of the owner's face.

/value/377/description.value: A pair of boxing gloves kept in excellent condition. Some slight wear doesn't hinder their effectiveness.

/value/378/description.value: A boxer's professional-level chest guard. The outer and inner padding is designed to provide protection while not hindering movement.

/value/379/description.value: Intricately crafted from leather and mesh, the combination of a thick insole and thin outsole ensures the wearer can be agile on their feet.

/value/38/description.value: A belt harness that connects the winged suit with metal supports embedded in thick linen. Soft and tight-fitting.

/value/380/description.value: A standard-issue helmet that covers the head and face. It has lining inside to help keep its wearer warm.

/value/381/description.value: Metal gauntlets that give off a silvery sparkle. A complex mechanical structure is hidden within its design.

/value/382/description.value: A neatly-ironed uniform of the Silvermane Guards from long ago. The sturdy buttons press creases in the fabric.

/value/383/description.value: A pair of hard, silver-white metal greaves. They provide protection while also being lightweight and warm.

/value/384/description.value: Protective goggles crafted from dark-black fire crystals. Through these lenses, even the flurry of intense sparks becomes a mosaic of dull shadows.

/value/385/description.value: A ring with a symbol of flames. It is the highest symbol of honor among the Firesmith clan.

/value/386/description.value: A blacksmith's apron without any superfluous adornment. The texture of the leather and the family emblem are clearly visible.

/value/387/description.value: A prosthetic produced from metallic alloy. Its surface is entwined with vivid fiery carvings.

/value/388/description.value: A pair of communication goggles embedded with ultraremote sensing technology that breaks through the shackles of limited transmission and remote distances.

/value/389/description.value: A pair of gloves equipped with a precision frequency-capture device, which enables direct manipulation of otherwise-intangible sound and light vibrations.

/value/39/description.value: Puttees to keep the legs warm during flights, decorated with a skyfish eagle's bristle feathers.

/value/390/description.value: Diving-suit-like attire that envelops the body when activated, sending neural signals from your whole body to the metafield in real time.

/value/391/description.value: A wearable gravity-capture device. It is shaped like a pair of ice skates that reflects the stars' twinkling lights during quick gliding.

/value/392/description.value: A pair of classic sunglasses worn by one of the lead singers, Janis, whose chrome lenses reflect a blue hue.

/value/393/description.value: Bassist Sid's bracelet, woven from silk wristbands from tours. Several lines of lyrics are written on it.

/value/394/description.value: David, one of the band's lead singers, drew a white star on the back of this leather jacket and made it the cover of the band's final album.

/value/395/description.value: Drummer Bonham's ankle boots, the dark leather surface glued with rivets reflecting the stage lights.

/value/396/description.value: An aerodynamic helmet used in high-speed flights. It is shaped like the beak of a skyfish eagle.

/value/397/description.value: A ring worn by an outstanding skyfisher master, with a pair of skyfish eagle's wings holding tight the wearer's finger.

/value/398/description.value: A belt harness that connects the winged suit with metal supports embedded in thick linen. Soft and tight-fitting.

/value/399/description.value: Puttees to keep the legs warm during flights, decorated with a skyfish eagle's bristle feathers.

/value/4/description.value: A cowboy hat decorated with wild wheat — a mark of the legendary Musketeer Oakley.

/value/40/description.value: A mask used to change one's facial appearance. Coupled with evocative acting skills, it can help you deceive anyone.

/value/400/description.value: A mask used to change one's facial appearance. Coupled with evocative acting skills, it can help you deceive anyone.

/value/401/description.value: A pair of special gloves interlaced with nanomaterials. The prints on its surface can change in real time.

/value/402/description.value: A steel cable disguised as a woven belt, with hooks and pulleys hidden in its buckle.

/value/403/description.value: A pair of boots that enhances any human's physical prowess. It helps the Meteor Thief stride between buildings.

/value/404/description.value: A breathing mask able to filter sand and radiation out from the air. It seems like it was made from a discarded respirator.

/value/405/description.value: Multi-functional trash that can detect ionizing radiation in the air. It can also trash-talk.

/value/406/description.value: A baggy robe adapted from a missionary's attire.

/value/407/description.value: The leg part of powered armor, an exoskeleton made from scrap metals and old wires.
